data.name: INK Mountains And Rivers
data.detailed_description:
《INK Mountains And Rivers》is a casual ink style idle collection and cultivation game, with themes taken from worldviews similar to Shanhaijing and Honghuang. It is a mountain and river world full of exotic treasures and beasts. Here, you can collect various exotic beasts, cultivate them to become stronger, break through bloodlines to enhance your realm, and even cultivate them into the form of a beast queen.

《界墨山河》是一款水墨风格的休闲挂机收集养成类游戏，题材取自类似山海经和洪荒的世界观，是一个全是奇珍异兽的山河世界。在这里，你可以收集各种异兽，培养它们变强，突破血脉提升境界，甚至可以修炼化形成兽姬形态。

There are various gameplay options in the game, including dispatching them to participate in battles, explorations, tree cutting, mining, farming, medicine refining, equipment refining, and more.

游戏中拥有各种玩法，可派遣它们参与战斗、探索、砍树、挖矿、种田、炼药，炼器等等。

Battle 战斗 

  • You can deploy 1 to 5 characters to engage in battles, adjusting team compositions based on their unique skills and talents, and challenge stages to obtain various resources.

    你可以派遣1-5个角色上阵参与战斗，根据不同角色的技能天赋调整阵容搭配，挑战关卡获取各种资源。

Building a campsite 建设营地

There are 18 buildings in the game, each with a corresponding functional system or gameplay.

To unlock new buildings and features, it is necessary to collect various materials through various means such as combat, exploration, and production decomposition to build a campsite.

游戏内有18个建筑，每个建筑都有对应的功能系统或玩法。

想解锁新建筑与新功能，需要通过战斗、探索、制作分解等各种途径手段收集各类材料用来建设营地。

Plant 种田

When lacking resources or leisure time, one can also cultivate various spiritual plants, exotic grasses, and other materials in the fields to obtain them.

缺乏资源或休闲时，也可以在作田内种田获取各种灵株异草等各种物资

Alchemy 炼药 

Collect various exotic fire and herbal materials, which can be pounded, decocted, and refined at the pharmacy to obtain better cultivation materials and maximize the effectiveness of the medicine.

收集各种异火和草药材料，可以在药坊处捣药、煎汤、炼丹，获得更好的修炼物资，使药物效果最大化。

Evolution/Personification 角色突破血脉进阶/兽姬化

Beasts can evolve (break through bloodlines) into new race characters. Starting from the first stage character (entering the realm of the world traveler), each character has a corresponding form of Beast Hime, which can be cultivated and transformed into Beast Hime when certain conditions are met.

异兽们可以进化（突破血脉）变成新的种族角色。1阶角色（入世行者境）开始，每个角色都有对应的兽姬形态，当满足一定条件时即可修炼化形成兽姬。

The preliminary setting of the game character has a total of 11 Stage:

游戏角色初步设定共有11个境界:

先天元灵(元灵境) → 入世行者(行者境) → 不羁轻狂(轻狂境) → 扶摇红尘(红尘境) → 自在逍遥(逍遥境) → 神游龙门(神游境) → 大罗万象(万象境) → 返璞归真(归真境) → 无止问道(问道境) → 永恒圣尊(圣尊境) → 无上鸿蒙(鸿蒙境)

Collecting 收集异兽

The game has an illustrated system with a wide variety of races and characters that need to be obtained and collected through different channels.

If possible, homeless people can be accommodated at the campfire;

Interact with NPCs to obtain their offspring;

Obtaining specific race characters through trap hunting, etc.

游戏设有图鉴系统，有超多种族和角色需要通过不同途径获取和收集。

如可在篝火处可以收留流浪者；

与NPC交互获取它的子嗣；

通过陷阱狩猎获得特定种族角色等等

PS: Currently, the development has only reached Stage3 (Red Dust Realm), and future development will gradually improve and perfect the realm roles

PS：目前开发只做到了3阶(红尘境)，后续开发会逐步提高和完善境界角色

The game world view and character demand are relatively large, and it is not yet fully formed. New content and characters will be updated and added from time to time.

游戏世界观和角色需求量比较庞大，目前还不是完全形态，会不定时更新加入新内容，新角色。

PS: Due to the author's insufficient English proficiency, the above is a machine translation. Sorry for the inconvenience.
